llm.title: AI assistant
llm.intro: Explains mistakes and tutors in lessons. Works with a model on this computer (LM Studio) or in the cloud (OpenRouter). Lesson content and your answers go only to the provider you choose.
llm.lmstudioHint: LM Studio runs the model on this computer. SprachAnker starts its server, loads the chosen model and can download suggested models into it.
llm.openrouterKeyHint: Create a key at openrouter.ai/keys. It is stored encrypted on this computer and never shown again.
llm.keyHint: Only if the server needs one. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
llm.keySaved: Saved — enter a new one to replace it
llm.connected: Connected · {count, plural, =0 {no models} one {# model} other {# models}} · {ms} ms
llm.modelHint: Pick one of the provider's models, or choose “Another model” to type its name.
llm.setUpHint: Want an explanation? Set up the AI assistant

error.llm_not_configured: Choose a model in Settings → AI assistant.
error.llm_unreachable: The server does not answer. Check the address.
error.lmstudioDown: LM Studio does not answer. Is its local server running?
error.llm_unauthorized: The API key was not accepted.
error.llm_model_not_found: The model was not found on the server.
error.llm_timeout: The model took too long to answer.
error.llm_lmstudio_missing: LM Studio is not installed on this computer.
error.llm_lmstudio_remote: LM Studio runs on another computer: start its server there.
error.llm_invalid_output: The model could not give a usable answer. Try again, or choose a larger model in Settings → AI assistant.
error.no_active_scene: This scene has ended. Start a new one.
error.no_such_item: This exercise has changed. Reload the lesson.
error.llm_cli_missing: The command-line assistant is not installed on this computer.

cliHint.claude-code: Runs Claude Code installed on this computer (`claude -p`) with your Claude subscription. Its own tools are off: lesson data goes in the prompt. Each answer starts the command, so replies take a few seconds longer.
cliHint.codex: Runs the Codex CLI installed on this computer (`codex exec`) with your ChatGPT subscription, read-only and without its tools. Each answer starts the command, so replies take a few seconds longer.

cliMissing.claude-code: Claude Code is not installed here. Install it from claude.com/claude-code and sign in once by running `claude`.
cliMissing.codex: The Codex CLI is not installed here. Install it (npm i -g @openai/codex) and sign in once with `codex login`.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.sizeValue: {chars, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} ≈ {tokens, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}}
prompt.infoIntro: Every request sends standing rules (the system prompt) and course data of the current lesson. Long parts are cut to the limits below so that small local models keep up.

part.item: the exercise item: task, options or gaps, the correct answer and your answer
part.knownVocab: words of earlier lessons (the most recent first)
part.exercise: the exercise on screen with its answers (the tutor gives hints first)
part.history: the latest messages of the conversation
part.mistakes: your mistakes: in this lesson, then the latest of earlier lessons (fixed ones marked)
part.tools: on request (tools): your progress, mistakes in any lesson, where a word is taught, what a lesson covers
part.sessionMistakes: your mistakes in this session and the exercises done without one

prompt.upTo: up to {chars, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
prompt.debugHint: Next to explanations and in the tutor: the exact request with all messages, for debugging.

scene.intro: Practise the lesson in a short role-play: the partner speaks the course language, corrects you and ticks off your goals.

about.title: About SprachAnker
about.intro: A self-hosted, local-first language tutor: real courses in one player, progress and speech on your own computer, any AI model you connect. Free and open source.

progress.courseBody: All answers and lesson runs of this course are deleted, with the tutor chats, writing checks, reviews and scenes about it. The course leaves “My courses” but stays installed. This cannot be undone.
progress.lessonBody: All answers and runs of this lesson are deleted, with its tutor chat, writing checks, reviews and scenes. This cannot be undone.

download.done: Downloaded. {failed, plural, =0 {All media are in place.} one {# file could not be downloaded.} other {# files could not be downloaded.}}
download.hint: Downloading fetches what is missing from the source (stored pages and media are kept) and prepares the course again; your progress stays.

storage.title: Storage
storage.intro: Courses, media and your progress live in this folder on the computer running SprachAnker. It is chosen when the server starts (--data, or SPRACHANKER_DATA); the desktop app will let you change it.
